CheckTitle: MFA has not been enabled for root
Description: The root user does not have any Multi-facter Authentication (MFA) device set up.
Risk: Root is the most privileged user in the AWS Account, and so in the possibility of compromised root credentials, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) serves as an additional protection against unauthorized access.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure MFA is enabled for all users when possible, and especially for high-privilege users such as root.
